body:
The edit-item dialog is an AlertDialog: it has a scrim you can tap to cancel
(easy to lose edits), and when the soft keyboard is up the Save/Cancel buttons
are hidden behind it — you must dismiss the keyboard to reach them. Make it a
full-screen dialog (no dismiss-on-click-outside) with a fixed header and a fixed
Cancel/Save action bar that stays above the keyboard, and a scrollable field
area, so the whole form is reachable while typing.
title: App: make the edit-item dialog full-screen and scrollable with the keyboard up
